A1.justification: Both complete, readable 18-page PDFs describe IndexMem and include Appendices A–E. Text and rendered-page comparisons support reliable assessment of all dimensions.

before.justification: v1 reports original RULER, NIAH, LongBench, reasoning, and efficiency experiments in Section 4, plus additional empirical analyses and results in Appendices B–C.

after.justification: v2 retains the original experimental results in Section 4 and Appendices B–C, including benchmark comparisons, memory ablations, and cross-layer score analyses.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Appendices B/E retain identical indexer architecture, training losses, latent-memory read/write procedures, residual compensation, and IndexCache-style score-reuse variant.

E1.justification: LongAlpaca training and RULER, NIAH, LongBench, AIME25, and Math500 evaluation coverage are unchanged, including the tasks and context scenarios reported in the appendices.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged throughout. Table 1 retains its model-specific baseline sets; Table 3 retains AdaKV, SnapKV, and TOVA; Table 5 retains xKV and Locret.

E3.justification: Backbones, metrics, compression budgets, training protocols, and the 128-token decoding compression interval are identical. Table 3's WSD training and score-reuse setting, distinguished from Table 1 in Appendix B.3, already appear in v1.

E4.justification: The NIAH stress test, memory ablations, efficiency analysis, and Appendix B cross-layer aggregation/reuse studies are identical. No ablation, robustness test, or supplementary analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged. Neither version supplies repeated-run or seed counts, confidence intervals, or significance tests for the reported experiments.

E6.justification: All numerical results, plotted outcomes, and reported findings are unchanged, including appendix results. For example, Table 6 retains IndexMem's LongBench averages of 55.26 at 50% compression and 36.51 at 90% compression.

T1.justification: The mathematical formulations in Sections 2–3 and Appendices B/D are identical, including attention, memory updates, entropy gating, and tensor definitions. No formal assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about learned token selection, latent-memory compensation, and long-context performance under KV-cache compression.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and applicability qualifications are unchanged, including Appendix A's training and model-coverage limitations, Appendix B's entropy-proxy caveats, and Appendix C's qualification about Locret's retrieval advantage.

D1.justification: Section 4's hyperparameters, hardware and KVPRESS information, Appendix B's score-reuse details, and Appendix E's pseudocode are unchanged. No technical or code/data access information is added.

R1.justification: Related-work positioning and the complete reference list are unchanged. The Hsieh et al. and Tang et al. entries move to subsequent pages because of reflow; they are not new citations.

P1.justification: v2 reverses the order of the final two authors, Yike Guo and Sirui Han, updates the version/date stamp, and adds a short funding Acknowledgements section before References. Scientific prose and narrative organization otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The acknowledgement shifts the References heading downward and reflows bibliography entries across pages 9–11. All figures, tables, captions, and appendix layouts remain identical.

improvement.justification: v2 adds funding attribution and makes author-order and associated layout edits. The scientific exposition, empirical evidence, limitations, and reproducibility information remain unchanged throughout the main text and appendices, so these administrative changes do not establish a meaningful overall quality difference.
